<function name="SetVerticalFOV" parent="ProjectedTexture" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the vertical angle of projection without affecting the horizontal angle.

You must call <page>ProjectedTexture:Update</page> after using this function for it to take effect.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="vFOV" type="number">The new vertical Field Of View for the projected texture. Must be in range between 0 and 180.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
